reason: The Select budgets combobox has autocomplete="garbage", an invalid token set next to data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore and data-bwignore, so autofill suppression is deliberate. The field picks which of Jane's existing budgets back the card, not information about the user, and the tree still exposes combobox Select budgets, so no A or AA criterion fails.
criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose applies only to fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in its Input Purposes list (name, address, email, card number and so on). Select budgets chooses which existing budgets a new card draws on, which is card configuration, so no listed purpose matches and 1.3.5 does not apply. The tree still exposes combobox Select budgets with its expanded state and popup, so 4.1.2 holds. No other A or AA criterion covers the autocomplete token.
